theme_archetype: Organic & Earthy (Archetype 1) mixed with Swiss High-Contrast structural grids
emotional_goal: Transforming stressful calendar management into a calm, focused, and highly legible experience through organic tones and precision grids.

typography.strategy: The 'Soft Utility' pairing to balance the rigid calendar grids.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tight leading-none font-light text-primary-900
scales.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight leading-tight text-primary-900

rules: NEVER use Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans for headings.
Always apply strict letter-spacing rules: tighter for large text, looser for small uppercase labels.
Maintain a 5.3:1 ratio for extreme contrast in headers vs labels (e.g., Month Name vs Day of Week).
Tinted Grey Rule: All greys MUST have a slight warm (yellow/orange) tint. Never use pure #000000 or neutral #808080.
Use #C25E4B (Terracotta) strictly for primary actions (Create Event, Save Preferences).
Use #4A6E53 (Moss Green) specifically for the Voice Scheduling UI to indicate active 'listening/recording' state.

calendar_grid.rule: Use high-transparency grid lines (rgba(0,0,0,0.09)) for calendar borders to guide the eye without competing with event blocks.

voice_activation_pill.classes: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-white/70 backdrop-saturate-150 border border-white/40 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] rounded-full
voice_activation_pill.active_state: Add animated gradient border or intense drop-shadow drop-shadow-[0_0_12px_rgba(74,110,83,0.4)] when listening.

dropdowns_and_modals.rule: CRITICAL: NEVER use a completely transparent background. All dropdowns, popovers, and sticky headers must have a solid background or heavy backdrop-blur with minimum 80% opacity to ensure text remains readable.

layout_and_grids.container: w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-12
layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use p-6 or p-8 inside cards. Use gap-6 or gap-8 between bento grid items.

role_specific_layouts.Admin: Data-heavy. Use grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6. One col-span-3 for User Management Table, one col-span-1 for System Stats.
role_specific_layouts.Manager: Team overview. Horizontal timeline view on top (col-span-full), team member list below (grid-cols-2).
role_specific_layouts.User: Personal focus. Large monthly/weekly calendar taking col-span-8, with an 'Upcoming Meetings' & 'Preferences' sidebar taking col-span-4.

forms_and_inputs: Use Shadcn UI components for logic but strip the default Vercel-look.
Inputs: rounded-md, bg-transparent, border-slate-300, focus:border-primary focus:ring-1 focus:ring-primary.
Notification Preferences Panel: Use Shadcn Switch/Toggle for Email/SMS/Voice Call. Group them in a clean list with generous padding (py-4) and a 1px border-b between items.
calendar_ui: Avoid standard off-the-shelf calendar look. Build an interactive grid with Tailwind CSS.
Event blocks should not touch the grid edges. Leave 2px of negative space around event pills.
Event pills: rounded-sm, px-2 py-1, text-xs font-medium truncate, bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border-l-2 border-orange-500.
voice_interface: Implement a prominent floating action button (FAB) or bottom-docked pill for the microphone.
Include a real-time transcription feedback area: text should appear with a slight fade-in animation as they speak.
Use Lucide-react icons for the microphone (e.g., Mic, MicOff).

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: All buttons must explicitly define hover text colors (e.g., hover:bg-primary-hover hover:text-white). Slightly lift cards (-translate-y-0.5).
motion_and_interaction.entrance_animations: Stagger the entrance of dashboard widgets and calendar events using framer-motion or simple CSS keyframes.
motion_and_interaction.voice_pulse: When voice recording is active, use a subtle ping or pulse animation on the microphone icon wrapper.

icons.style: Use stroke-width 1.5 for a sophisticated, lighter appearance.

rules: Avatars should map directly to user roles.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: CRITICAL: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs, toggles, calendar days, event blocks) MUST include a kebab-case data-testid attribute based on role.
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure text contrast on primary buttons meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_testing.reduced_motion: Wrap continuous animations (like the voice recording pulse) in a prefers-reduced-motion media query check.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You are building a React application using .js/.jsx files. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Avoid the generic 'AI slop' aesthetic. Do not make generic centered layouts. Left-align dense content.
Create depth through layered design elements (z-index hierarchy) but avoid overusing heavy shadows. Use 1px borders and subtle ambient shadow.
NEVER use completely transparent backgrounds for elements overlapping content (dropdowns, modals, floating voice UI).
Do not center-align the main App container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Use micro-animations for interactions (hover states, focus rings, expanding sidebars).
Use existing Shadcn UI primitives from src/components/ui/ when possible, adapting their styles to fit the Earthy/Swiss theme.
